title: Bluetooth
summary: Misinformation spreads false claims about Bluetooth causing cancer, being highly insecure, or being fundamentally dangerous to human health.
introduction: Bluetooth technology faces significant misinformation campaigns that exaggerate health risks, security vulnerabilities, and general safety concerns. These myths often stem from misunderstanding of electromagnetic radiation types, conflating Bluetooth with more powerful radio frequencies, and overstating relatively minor security risks that can be easily mitigated with proper device management.
